# International Students

Share on |

## Contenu de la page principale

You are an international student and you would like to enrol at the University of Orléans?  
Please check the procedure corresponding to your situation below, or contact us via the [contact form](https://www.univ-orleans.fr/fr/univ/defi-etdudiants-etrangers-formulaire-contact).

---

|  |
| --- |
| Important Before any registration, if you are not a French speaker, you must take a [French language proficiency test](https://www.univ-orleans.fr/fr/idf/certifications/tcf).  Your application file must include a certificate attesting to a **minimum B2 level in French**. |

#### Accomodation

The [Crous of Orléans-Tours](https://www.crous-orleans-tours.fr/) is a partner organisation of the University of Orléans that, among other services, offers student accommodation. You may [apply for Crous housing](https://trouverunlogement.lescrous.fr/) from July 7, 2026.

**However, the Crous cannot accommodate all students due to a large number of applications.**  
As a result, we strongly encourage you to start looking for alternative accommodation solutions as early as possible, in order to avoid housing difficulties upon your arrival at the University of Orléans. Indeed, the Crous will most likely not be able to meet your request at the start of the academic year, as all accommodation will already have been allocated.  
  
**You will find below a list of student housing options that are alternatives to Crous accommodation:**

File

[2026\_DEVE\_Housing informations 2026-2027 (English)\_1.pdf](https://www.univ-orleans.fr/upload/public/2026-05/2026_DEVE_Housing%20informations%202026-2027%20%28English%29_1.pdf "Open file in new window")402.98 KB

#### ["  Applying for the 1st year of a Bachelor’s Program (L1) "](#faq-collapse-1)

#### Do you hold, or will you obtain, a foreign high school diploma and currently live abroad?

You must submit a [Preliminary Admission Application (DAP – “white file”)](https://www.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/fr/dossier-blanc-demande-d-admission-prealable-dap-pour-une-premiere-inscription-dans-une-universite-46452) to the **Cultural Service of the French Embassy** in your country **between October 1 and December 15**.

To make sure that the program you are interested in is open to first-year Bachelor’s applications, please use the dedicated [contact form](https://www.univ-orleans.fr/fr/univ/deve-etudiants-etrangers-formulaire-contact).

For applicants residing in a country with a **Études en France Center**, the DAP application for the first year of a Bachelor’s degree must be submitted exclusively online through the [Études en France platform](https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance/) **between October 1 and December 15** (the deadline may be earlier in some countries).

**Please note that some programs are not open to applications for the first year of a Bachelor’s degree.**

#### Do you hold a foreign high school diploma and reside permanently in France?

You must submit a [Preliminary Admission Application (DAP – “green file”)](https://www.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/cid24146/-dossier-vert-demande-d-admission-prealable-en-premiere-annee-de-licence.html) by email to the Central Student Services Office at [deve.scol@univ-orleans.fr](mailto:deve.scol@univ-orleans.fr) **between October 1 and December 15**.

To confirm that the program you are interested in accepts first-year Bachelor’s applications, please use the dedicated [contact form](https://www.univ-orleans.fr/fr/univ/deve-etudiants-etrangers-formulaire-contact).

#### Do you hold, or will you obtain, a French Baccalauréat abroad?

You may submit your application online through the [Parcoursup](https://www.parcoursup.fr/) platform **between January and March**.

#### Are you stateless, a refugee, or a beneficiary of subsidiary protection recognized by OFPRA?

You are exempt from the Preliminary Admission Application (DAP). You may request an application file by email at [deve.scol@univ-orleans.fr](mailto:deve.scol@univ-orleans.fr) **before June 15**.

#### ["  Applying for the 1st year of a BUT Program "](#faq-collapse-2)

#### Would you like to apply to the first year of a BUT program?

You must submit your application online through the [Parcoursup platform](https://www.parcoursup.fr/) **between January and March.**

For applicants residing in a country with a **Études en France center**, you must apply online through the [Études en France platform](https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance/dyn/public/authentification/login.html) **between October 1 and December 31** (the deadline may be earlier in some countries).

For applicants residing in a country with a **Études en France center**, you must apply online through the [Études en France platform](https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance/dyn/public/authentification/login.html) **between October 1 and December 31** (the deadline may be earlier in some countries).

The request must specify the level and field of study requested, the applicant’s nationality, their place of residence, and their most recent diploma obtained, including the place where it was awarded.

You must apply online through the [Études en France platform](https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance/dyn/public/authentification/login.html) **between October 1 and December 31** (the deadline may be earlier in some countries).

#### **Applying for the second or third year of a BUT program, a Professional Bachelor’s degree, or the second year of a Master’s program?**

You may submit your application online through the [eCandidat platform](https://ecandidat.univ-orleans.fr/ecandidat-web/#!accueilView), **between February and June**, depending on the application period for each program.

##### 

#### **Applying for the first year of a Master’s program?**

You may submit your application online through the [MonMaster platform](https://candidature.monmaster.gouv.fr/), **between March and April**.

#### ["  Registration procedure 2026–2027 for international students admitted to the University of Orléans "](#faq-collapse-5)

|  |
| --- |
| **Please note that the University of Orléans does not issue late arrival certificates.** |

#### Before any administrative enrollment

All students enrolled in initial higher education programs **must obtain a proof of payment (or exemption, for scholarship students) of the Student and Campus Life Contribution (CVEC)** before registering at their institution.

To obtain your certificate:

* Log in or create an account on the [dedicated website](https://cvec.etudiant.gouv.fr/);
* Indicate your city of study;
* Pay the CVEC;
* Obtain the certificate number to provide during registration.

#### For students admitted to the Orléans–La Source campus:

You must go to the **Welcome Center** (*Guichet Unique*) **between August 24 and September 11, 2026**, from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

Adress of the Welcome Center:

* AIDE Office - « Parc Floral » tram stop
* [Science Lecture Halls Building, rue de Saint Amand, 45100 Orléans](https://goo.gl/maps/Ahqd46NQJpsPiAST9)

To prepare for your enrollment once you have obtained your visa:

* Create an account on MoveOn (French version) or MoveOn (English version);
* Download the first-time registration file (available from July 4);
* Complete it and attach the required supporting documents indicated in the file before submitting the form.  
  The Welcome Center will check that your file is complete and finalize your registration once you arrive in France.

**It is MANDATORY to complete the pre-registration form BEFORE your arrival. If you arrive at the Welcome Center without having filled out the form, you will not be able to register on site and will have to return once the form has been completed.**

After completing your registration, you must activate your [ENT digital account](https://ent.univ-orleans.fr/) to access all useful information about the organization of your studies.

#### For students admitted to off-site campuses (Bourges, Chartres, Chteauroux, Issoudun)

You must download the first-time registration file and follow the instructions provided.

* File available from July 1

To be sent by email to the relevant Student Services Office ([see the contact list](https://www.univ-orleans.fr/fr/univ/formation/contacts)).

Once you arrive, you must go to your Student Services Office to finalize your registration (payment, administrative information).

# Procédure de candidature Bourse Eiffel

Partager sur |

## Contenu de la page principale

Toutes les informations pour candidater à la Bourse France Excellence Eiffel à l'Université d'Orléans

---

[Le programme de bourses France Excellence Eiffel](https://www.campusfrance.org/fr/le-programme-de-bourses-eiffel) est un outil développé par le Ministère de l’Europe et des Affaires étrangères afin de permettre aux établissements français d’enseignement supérieur d’attirer les meilleurs étudiants étrangers dans des formations diplômantes de niveau master et en doctorat.

Il permet de former les futurs décideurs étrangers, des secteurs privé et public, dans les domaines d’études prioritaires, et de stimuler les candidatures d’étudiants originaires de pays émergents gés de 29 ans maximum pour le niveau master et de pays émergents et industrialisés gés de 35 ans au plus pour le niveau doctorat.

Image

![Bourse Eiffel](/upload/public/styles/univ_wysiwyg_big/public/2019-09/BoursesEiffel.jpg?h=6ab5974d&itok=jSYc-u4G "Bourse Eiffel")

|  |
| --- |
| La campagne 2026-2027 est terminée |
| Prochaine campagne : octobre 2026 |

## Avant de soumettre une candidature :

#### ❶ Lire attentivement la Réglementation de la Bourse Eiffel destinée aux étudiants :

Fichier

[REGLEMENTATION\_LAUREATS\_Eiffel\_2026.pdf](https://www.univ-orleans.fr/upload/public/2025-10/REGLEMENTATION_LAUREATS_Eiffel_2026.pdf "Open fichier in new window")335.84 Ko

#### ❷ Consulter la liste des formations éligibles à l'Université d'Orléans :

Fichier

[2026-27\_Formations\_eligibles\_Bourse\_Eiffel\_0.pdf](https://www.univ-orleans.fr/upload/public/2025-10/2026-27_Formations_eligibles_Bourse_Eiffel_0.pdf "Open fichier in new window")238.78 Ko

#### ❸ Vérifier votre éligibilité au programme :

* **Origine des dossiers :** toutes les candidatures doivent obligatoirement passer par la Direction des Relations Internationales de l'Université d'Orléans ([bourse.eiffel@univ-orleans.fr](mailto:bourse.eiffel@univ-orleans.fr)) qui centralise toutes les demandes et envoie les dossiers à Campus France. En aucun cas l'étudiant ne doit envoyer sa candidature directement à Campus France ou au responsable de formation, celle-ci sera d'emblée rejetée. De plus, un candidat présenté par plus d'un établissement verra  sa candidature également rejetée.
* **Nationalité :** ce programme est réservé aux candidats de nationalité étrangère. Les candidats binationaux, dont l’une des nationalités est française, ne sont pas éligibles.
* **Date de naissance :**
  + **Niveau Master** : le candidat doit être gé de 29 ans au plus au moment de la sélection des  
    candidatures 2026 ; c’est-à-dire né après le 31 mars 1996.
  + **Niveau Doctorat** : le candidat doit être gé de 35 ans au moment de la sélection des  
    candidatures 2026 ; c’est-à-dire né après le 31 mars 1990.
* **Bourse :** les étudiants bénéficiant déjà d’une bourse du gouvernement français au titre d’un autre programme au moment du dépôt de candidature, ne sont pas éligibles, même s’il s’agit d’une bourse de couverture sociale.
* **Adresse permanente :**
  + **Niveau Master** : les candidats en cours d’études en France sont inéligibles.
  + **Niveau Doctorat** : les candidats en cours d’études en France sont éligibles. Les étudiants en  
    cours d’études à l’étranger sont prioritaires sur ceux qui résident déjà en France.

---

## Comment candidater ?

#### **❶** Doctorat :

* Pour des candidats en 1ère année de thèse et primo-arrivants, la bourse est de 36 mois, il faut donc trouver un encadrant avant le 8 décembre 2025. Nous vous conseillons donc de contacter les équipes de recherche qui travaillent dans votre domaine de recherche: <https://www.univ-orleans.fr/fr/univ/recherche/laboratoires-et-structures>
* Pour les candidats déjà en cours de thèse dans le cadre d’une codirection ou cotutelle, la bourse est de 6 à 18 mois, en fonction de l’année d’inscription.  
    
  **Dans les deux cas, il appartient au responsable qui soutiendra la candidature de contacter** [**bourse.eiffel@univ-orleans.fr**](mailto:bourse.eiffel@univ-orleans.fr)

#### **❷** Master :

* **Étape 1** : Assembler dans un seul et même document PDF :  
  • votre CV  
  • une lettre de motivation / description du projet professionnel  
  • Les bulletins de notes des 3 dernières années avec traduction officielle si nécessaire. **N'oubliez pas que la bourse Eiffel est une bourse d'excellence.**  
  • La/Les document(s) attestant de votre classement dans la promotion, au moins l'année dernière. Toutefois, votre candidature aura plus de chances d'aboutir si vous pouvez fournir votre classement tout au long de votre carrière académique.   
    
  **Le document PDF doit être nommé comme suit :** NOM\_Prenom\_Justificatifs-M-Eiffel-UO
* **Étape 2**: Remplir le formulaire suivant :

## University of Orleans Overview

### History

Founded in 1306 by Pope Clement V, the University of Orléans is one of the oldest European universities.

It is renowned across Europe. It closed its doors during the French Revolution in 1793, like every other university in France. It came back to life in the 1960s with the creation of a campus in the South of Orléans.

### Education

The university has 3 faculties, 1 engineering university school (Polytech), 4 University Institutes of Technology (IUT), 1 Higher Schools for Professors and Educators (INSPE), 1 Observatory of the Sciences of the Universe (OSUC), 1 University school of physiotherapy (EUK).

### Research

Every year its international focus gets stronger. Its capacity for innovation is reflected in the dynamism of the research it leads and in the technology transfers to regional, national and international companies.
